inputs.text: An ornate brass and gold clockwork reliquary globe standing on an engraved bronze tripod, set against a dark warm background. Inside a hand-blown glass dome, a miniature sunlit clockwork citadel rises from a bed of amber crystal and warm crimson mineral dust, its spires wrapped in fine gold filigree gears. A pulsing amber-gold core glows at the center, casting warm reflections through the glass. Intricate engraved brass detailing along the base, small crimson gemstones set into the tripod feet, dramatic warm rim lighting, dark academia mood with a golden-hour glow instead of cool tones, photorealistic fantasy prop photography.
